quarantined_leads.lead: A Reddit post claimed that Ohio State Representative Elgin Rogers Jr. was arrested in Ottawa County on OVI, slow-driving, and firearm-handling charges.
quarantined_leads.reason: Single social-media report with no official police, court, agency, or reputable-news corroboration located in the 24-hour window. The official Ohio House source identifies Rogers as a Democratic representative, not a right-wing, Republican, conservative, or affiliated-organizational figure. No event was emitted.

coverage_gaps: No person-specific event involving a covered right-wing, Republican, conservative, or affiliated-organizational figure was located in Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, or Missouri that met the evidence and date-window rules.

Official state newsroom and law-enforcement indexes exposed mostly older July or June 2026 entries, and several search/index pages were not current enough to establish a complete statewide negative. Local police, sheriff, prosecutor, court, school-board, and municipal records are fragmented and not uniformly searchable from one public index.

Reputable regional-news searches for the 24-hour window returned no corroborated qualifying report. Several major local-news domains were blocked by robots.txt, so those outlets could not be independently inspected through the search tool.

Routine arrests and criminal matters without an explicitly documented covered political or affiliated role were excluded. Allegations, rumors, and partisan or social-media claims without corroboration remain quarantined rather than published.
